facts.business: Shri Venkatesh Refineries Limited is an Indian FMCG and agro-processing company engaged in the manufacturing, processing, refining, packaging, and distribution of edible oils (soybean, palm, sunflower, cottonseed, groundnut) and allied products like vanaspati under brands such as Rich Soya, Rich Sun, and Silver Gold.

capacity_or_capex.item: Solar power panels (650 KWH) for captive consumption

guidance_or_targets.statement: Aims to become the largest edible oil refining company and expand product portfolio (Soya, Sunflower, Palm, Mustard oil) and distribution network.

auditor.name: Not explicitly named in the provided text (referred to as 'Independent Auditors')

key_risks: High dependence on edible oil imports (>50% of India's requirement)
Sensitivity to international commodity prices, exchange rates, and geopolitical developments
Concentration of distribution network primarily in Maharashtra
